# Configuration Checklist: ISK-0007 — Container Entry Points & Process Separation

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for configuration roots, the environment name, precedence, and the `container` section are complete, clear, and consistent
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Configuration Roots

- [x] CHK001 - Are the configuration directory, its default, and the override variable specified, with the different outcomes for an absent default directory and an absent named one? [Completeness, Spec §TR-3, Contract §Configuration roots 1, 7]
- [x] CHK002 - Are the base and overlay file names fixed, including case sensitivity and the `.yaml`/`.json` ambiguity rule? [Clarity, Spec §TR-3, Contract §Configuration roots 2, 7]
- [x] CHK003 - Is it defined how an environment name that breaks ISK-0003's rule interacts with forming the overlay file name? [Gap, Security, Contract §Configuration roots 2]
  - Settled in `checklist`: ISK-0003's environment-name rule 2 checks a given name before any document is read. An overlay file name is now formed only from a name that meets that rule, so a name such as `../x` never becomes a path, and the name is passed on for ISK-0003 to reject with `config.environment.invalid`. Contract Configuration roots rule 2, research R8, data model, and T013 say so.
- [x] CHK004 - Is a present but empty `ISKENDER_ENVIRONMENT` or `ISKENDER_CONFIG_DIRECTORY` defined, as set or unset? [Edge Case, Gap, Contract §Configuration roots 4]
  - Maintainer decision in `checklist` (2026-11-15): a present but empty variable counts as unset. An empty `ISKENDER_ENVIRONMENT` gives no environment name, which is production-grade, and an empty `ISKENDER_CONFIG_DIRECTORY` selects `/etc/iskender`. The spec's Clarifications and Edge Cases, contract Configuration roots rule 4, research R8, the data model, and T013 say so.
- [x] CHK005 - Is an existing but unreadable layer file given a failure, code, exit code, and events, distinct from a missing layer? [Coverage, Contract §Configuration roots 7, Hosting contract §Start-up 4]

## Environment and Precedence

- [x] CHK006 - Is it stated that the environment name comes only from `ISKENDER_ENVIRONMENT`, and that unset is production-grade? [Clarity, Spec §TR-3, §FR-009, Contract §Configuration roots 4]
- [x] CHK007 - Is every ASP.NET Core source that must not reach Iskender listed: environment variables, `appsettings*.json`, command-line arguments, and URL settings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Contract §Configuration roots 6, Research R7]
- [x] CHK008 - Is precedence defined as ISK-0003's, with no further layer, for every topology? [Consistency, Spec §TR-4, Contract §Configuration roots 5, Hosting contract §Registration 4]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the result of a document holding the other plane's section defined, with its code? [Edge Case, Spec §TR-4, §Edge Cases, Contract §Configuration roots 8]
- [x] CHK010 - Is it shown that `ISKENDER_CONFIG_DIRECTORY` and `ISKENDER_ENVIRONMENT` cannot be read as `ISKENDER__` configuration paths? [Clarity, Research R8]

## The `container` Section

- [x] CHK011 - Is every field of the `container` section given a type, default, range, and development-only flag? [Completeness, Spec §TR-6, Contract §The container section]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the equal-ports rule given a failure point, code, field path, and exit code, and is it consistent across spec, contract, research, and tasks? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Command line 2, Research R9, Tasks T012]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the port range justified by binding as a non-root user? [Clarity, Spec §TR-6]
- [x] CHK014 - Is it stated that listeners are bound only from the validated section, and never from ASP.NET Core settings? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Listeners 1, Research R9]
- [x] CHK015 - Is event 6001 required to name every document used, so an operator can tell which files were read? [Measurability, Contract §Configuration roots 9]
